correctness.rationale: For 0<t<1 developing azimuthal separation delta in [0,pi] gives chord d²=r²+s²−2rs cos(t delta); competitors with angular winding >=pi have length >=r+s by radial angular crossing, and local chords do not exit the rim disk. Maximizing over theta and radial s gives eccentricity max{r,sqrt(r²+L²−2rL cos(pi t))}; elementary constrained minimization has three regimes with sharp t=1/4,1/2. Normalized lateral area has s-density 2s/L² and angular delta uniform [0,pi], giving Fréchet quadratic with minimizer r_F=(2L/3) sin(pi t)/(pi t). Monotone sin2beta/(2beta) and tan(beta)/beta yield exactly two coincidence roots, product radial convexity yields diameter, and branch monotonicity sharp sqrt(3)/2 ratio at t=1/3. Independent calculations checked 99 cone shapes and both root numerical solutions 0.2030336599850761, 0.30793382365126515; finite grids are not continuum proofs.
